e.title: 开篇一句话划出三条边界：**刻意不提供保险建议或保障推荐**、**AI 只起草可编辑的行政邮件草稿**、**本应用不发送任何邮件**；而那个未实现的计费端点会**明确返回 501**，并说明原因是「产品与价格 ID 以及计费政策未提供」
e.title_en: Three boundaries in the opening sentence — it deliberately does not provide insurance advice or coverage recommendations, the AI only drafts editable administrative email copy, and no email is sent by the application — while the unimplemented billing endpoint returns an explicit 501 with the reason that product and price identifiers and billing policy were not supplied
e.title_hk: 開篇一句話劃出三條邊界：**刻意不提供保險建議或保障推薦**、**AI 只起草可編輯的行政郵件草稿**、**本應用不發送任何郵件**；而那個未實現的計費端點會**明確返回 501**，並說明原因是「產品與價格 ID 以及計費政策未提供」
e.summary: 一份面向保险经纪人的 **CRM 与续保管理平台**（自称「production-oriented MVP」）：管理**客户记录、保单、续保时间线**与**行政跟进**，**首页线上部署为 Vercel**；**其最值得记的一处是开篇一句里同时划出三条能力边界**——**逐字「It **intentionally does not provide insurance advice or coverage recommendations**. **AI only drafts editable administrative email copy**; **no email is sent by the application**.」**：**① 刻意不给保险建议与保障推荐；② AI 只**起草可编辑的行政邮件草稿**；③ **本应用不发送任何邮件****——**⭐ 即「AI 做什么、不做什么、以及它做的产物由谁发出」被三句分完**；**另有三处同一纪律**：**① 一个声明为未实现的端点**——**逐字「Stripe-ready protected billing endpoint（**returns 501 until products are configured**）」**，**即**未实现的部分**会明确返回「未实现」**，**而不是假装可用或静默缺失**；**② 它逐字说明**为什么**那个东西没做**——**不是「即将推出」，而是**「因为产品／价格 ID 与计费政策**未被提供**」**；**③ 它把「还不能用于真实客户数据」写成一条前置清单**——**逐字「**add rate limiting/audit retention at the platform edge before handling real client data**」**，**即**在接手真实数据之前**还需要补两样东西**；**此外它的测试清单逐项可读**（**会话完整性、未鉴权 API 授权、客户与保单输入校验、续保分桶、跟进状态计算、AI 起草端点的授权**），**续保按**逾期／0–7 天／8–30 天／31 天以上**四桶划分**，**并按环境变量表逐项注明哪些是必需、哪些是可选**（含**AI 密钥「保存在服务端、绝不暴露给浏览器」**）
e.summary_hk: 一份面向保險經紀人的 **CRM 與續保管理平台**（自稱「production-oriented MVP」）：管理**客戶記錄、保單、續保時間線與行政跟進**，**首頁部署在 Vercel**；**其最值得記的一處是開篇一句裡同時劃出三條能力邊界**——**逐字「It **intentionally does not provide insurance advice or coverage recommendations**. **AI only drafts editable administrative email copy**; **no email is sent by the application**.」**：**① 刻意不給保險建議與保障推薦；② AI 只**起草可編輯的行政郵件草稿**；③ **本應用不發送任何郵件****——**⭐ 即「AI 做什麼、不做什麼、以及它做的產物由誰發出」被三句分完**；**另有三處同一紀律**：**① 一個聲明為未實現的端點**——**逐字「Stripe-ready protected billing endpoint（**returns 501 until products are configured**）」**，**即**未實現的部分會明確返回「未實現」**，**而不是假裝可用或靜默缺失**；**② 它逐字說明**為什麼**那個東西沒做**——**不是「即將推出」，而是**「因為產品／價格 ID 與計費政策未提供」**；**③ 它把「還不能用於真實客戶數據」寫成一條前置清單**——**逐字「**add rate limiting/audit retention at the platform edge before handling real client data**」**，**即**在接手真實數據之前還需要補兩樣東西**；**此外它的測試清單逐項可讀**（**會話完整性、未鑑權 API 授權、客戶與保單輸入校驗、續保分桶、跟進狀態計算、AI 起草端點的授權**），**續保按**逾期／0–7 天／8–30 天／31 天以上**四桶劃分**，**並按環境變量表逐項註明哪些是必需、哪些是可選**（含**AI 密鑰「保存在服務端、絕不暴露給瀏覽器」**）
e.summary_en: A CRM and renewal-management platform for insurance brokers, self-described as a production-oriented MVP, covering client records, policies, renewal timelines and administrative follow-ups, deployed with Vercel and linked from its repository; **its most notable feature is that the opening sentence draws three capability boundaries at once** — verbatim: it **intentionally does not provide insurance advice or coverage recommendations**; **the AI only drafts editable administrative email copy**; and **no email is sent by the application** — so what the AI does, what it does not do, and who sends its output are all settled in three clauses; **three further points follow the same discipline**: **first, an endpoint declared unimplemented** — a billing endpoint is described as returning 501 until products are configured, so the unfinished part answers plainly that it is not implemented rather than appearing to work or silently vanishing; **second, the reason it was not built is stated verbatim** — not that it is coming soon, but that product and price identifiers and billing policy were not supplied; **and third, what is still missing before real data may be handled is given as a checklist**, requiring rate limiting and audit retention at the platform edge before handling real client data; **additionally its test list is itemised** (session integrity, unauthenticated API authorization, client and policy input validation, renewal categorisation, follow-up status calculation, and authorization on the AI-draft endpoint), renewals are bucketed as overdue, zero to seven days, eight to thirty days and thirty-one days or more, and an environment-variable table marks each entry required or optional, including that the AI key is kept server-side and never exposed to the browser
e.body:
**brokerflow-renewal-crm**（仓库 `Astri299/brokerflow`，工具名 BrokerFlow）**是一份面向保险经纪人的 CRM 与续保管理平台**：**管理客户记录、保单、续保时间线与行政跟进**，**自称** **「a **production-oriented MVP** for insurance brokers」**，**其首页部署在 Vercel**（**实测 `homepage` 字段为 `https://brokerflow-nine.vercel.app`**）。**实测 ★0、fork 0、许可 **NONE**（**实测该仓库无任何许可文件**）、主语言 TypeScript、仓库体量 108 KB、**创建与最后推送均为 2026-09-08（同日）**、无 topics**（**均 GitHub API 实测值；创建与推送均在解冻窗口之内**）；**README 实测 2,619 字节**；**仓库实测共 98 个条目（63 个文件、35 个目录）**。本条目属于本轮主题**「按部分声明：许可、能力、交付物与使用者各自适用什么规则」**；**⭐⭐⭐ 它是四条里**把「能力按部分分」写得最干净的一条****。

可核实信息（**均 README 与仓库实测**）：⭐⭐⭐ **① 开篇一句里同时划出三条边界，且三条各管一件事**——**这是本条最值得单独记的一处**：**逐字为**：**「BrokerFlow is a **production-oriented MVP** for insurance brokers to manage client records, policies, renewal timelines, and administrative follow-ups. **It intentionally does not provide insurance advice or coverage recommendations. AI only drafts editable administrative email copy; no email is sent by the application.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **四处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **第一条否掉的是**这门生意的核心产出**（**保险建议与保障推荐**）**——**⭐ 即**一个经纪人的工具**明确说自己不给建议****；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **第二条把 AI 的作用**收窄到两个限定词**：「**只**起草」「**可编辑的**草稿」**——**⭐ 即**它既不自动决定内容，也不把草稿当成终稿****；**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **第三条回答了一个常被跳过的问题：**这个产物由谁发出****（**逐字「no email is sent by the application」，**本应用不发送任何邮件**）**——**⭐ 本词条认为三条里这一条最实在：**前两条说的是「不做什么」，这一条说的是**「做了也不会自己发出去」****；**④ **三句合起来**把「AI 做什么／不做什么／它的产物由谁发出」**分完了**，**且**全部写在第一段****。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **一个**声明为未实现的端点**，而它**明确返回「未实现」****——**逐字为**：**「**Stripe-ready protected billing endpoint（returns 501 until products are configured）**」**⭐⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **「未实现」被做成了**一个可观察的响应**（**HTTP 501**）**——**⭐ 即**调用方**不会以为它成功了**，**也不会遇到一个无解释的失败**；**② ⭐⭐ **它把这个端点**仍列在「Included（已包含）」清单里**，**同时**在括号里写明它的实际状态**——**⭐ 即**「已经有了架子」与「还不能用」**被同时说清**；**③ **本词条认为这与本站第 341 轮 [[kakekomi-corpus]] 的「gap 作为返回值」同族：**「尚不可用」被做成了一个**有类型、有名字的输出****。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **它逐字说明**为什么**那件事没做，而不是说「即将推出」****——**逐字为**：**「Stripe checkout/webhooks are **deliberately prepared but not activated because product/price IDs and billing policy were not supplied**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **它区分了**代码侧已完成**与**信息侧未提供**——**⭐ 即**未实现的原因**不在代码，而在**缺失的输入**（**产品／价格 ID 与计费政策**）**；**② ⭐⭐ **「deliberately prepared」**说明架子是**有意留的****（**⭐ 即**这不是遗漏**）；**③ ⭐ 本词条认为这是本站所收条目里**对「某个东西为什么还没做」写得最不含糊的一处之一****（**⭐ 与第 342 轮 [[ratecraft-reserving-pricing]] 的「a pricing-based prior would be the natural fix, **and I have not built or measured one**」同类**）。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **它把「还不能用于真实客户数据」写成了**一条前置清单****——**逐字为**：**「Use managed PostgreSQL with backups, configure `AUTH_SECRET` uniquely per environment, set `NODE_ENV=production`（**secure cookies; startup rejects a missing secret**），provision an OpenAI key only where drafting is desired, and **add rate limiting/audit retention at the platform edge before handling real client data**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **四处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **「在处理**真实客户数据之前**，先要在平台边缘加上限流与审计留存」**——**⭐ 即**它把**哪一步之前不能做什么**写清楚了**（**⭐ 本词条认为这是「按部分声明」在**使用者**维度上最实用的一处：**读者据此知道它现在**不该**被用在哪里**）；**② **其余前置项也逐条具体**（**托管数据库带备份／每个环境用不同的 `AUTH_SECRET`／设 `NODE_ENV=production`**）；**③ ⭐⭐ **「启动时会拒绝缺失的密钥」**——**⭐ 即**配置错误会让服务**起不来**，**而不是悄悄降级****；**④ ⭐⭐ **AI 密钥只在需要起草时才配**——**⭐ 即**不默认开启**。**⑤ ⭐⭐ **其测试清单逐项可读，且覆盖的正是上面那三条边界的实现面**——**逐字为**：**「The automated test suite covers **session integrity, unauthenticated API authorization, client/policy input validation, renewal categorization, follow-up status calculation, and AI-draft endpoint authorization**.」**；**验证命令逐字为** **「Run `npm run typecheck`, `npm test`, and `npm run build`.」**⭐⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **六项测试里有两项**指向授权与鉴权**（**未鉴权 API 授权、AI 起草端点的授权**）**——**⭐ 即**「谁能调用 AI 起草」是被测过的**（**⭐ 与第 342 轮 [[prediction-lab-actuarial]] 的「审批权限集成测试」同族**）；**② ⭐⭐ **「续保分桶」与「跟进状态计算」被单独列为测试项**——**⭐ 即**业务规则不只写在文档里**；**③ **验证是三件事**（**类型检查、测试、构建**）**，**而不是只有测试****。**⑥ ⭐⭐ **续保按四桶划分，边界明确**——**逐字为**：**「**Renewal buckets: overdue, 0–7 days, 8–30 days, and 31+ days**」**⭐⭐ **两处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐ **四桶的分界是**可核对的数字**（**逾期／0–7／8–30／31+**）**——**⭐ 即**「紧迫程度」被写成了**区间而不是形容词**；**② **「逾期」被**单列**成一桶**（**而非并入 0–7 天**）**。**⑦ ⭐ **其环境变量表逐项注明必需性与用途，且有一条隐私说明**——**逐字表为**：**`DATABASE_URL`（必需）／`AUTH_SECRET`（必需，**32+ 字节**）／`OPENAI_API_KEY`（**起草邮件时需要；保存在服务端；绝不暴露给浏览器**）／`OPENAI_MODEL`（可选，**默认为 `gpt-4o-mini`**）／Stripe 变量（可选，**保留**）**⭐⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **「保存在服务端；绝不暴露给浏览器」**是一条**明确的安全边界描述****（**⭐ 而非泛泛的「安全」**）；**② **必需与可选项**逐行区分**，**且**密钥有**长度要求**（32+ 字节**）；**③ **模型名给出**默认值**（**⭐ 即**不填也能跑**）。**⑧ ⭐⭐ **一处需如实指出的**已提交的演示凭据****——**逐字为**：**「The seed login is `demo@brokerflow.local` / `DemoPassword123!`; **use it only in local development**.」**⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① **演示账号与口令**被写进 README**；**② ⭐⭐ **它逐字标注**只能在本地开发使用****；**③ ⚠️ **本词条提示：**这类演示凭据若被误用到任何对外部署上，就是一处真实的口令弱化**——**⭐ 本词条**不主张**该项目已发生这种情况，**只指出该凭据是**公开可读的****（**⭐ 其 `NODE_ENV=production` 与「启动拒绝缺失密钥」两处说明作者对生产配置有意识**）。**⑨ ⭐ **其余可核实细节**：**① **会话用签名且 HttpOnly 的 cookie**；**② **「每个数据查询与每个 REST 端点都做按用户的授权」**；**③ **客户、保单与跟进都有 CRUD API 与操作界面**；**④ **技术栈为 Prisma ＋ PostgreSQL**（**含首个迁移与真实感的开发种子数据**）**；**⑤ **AI 起草**必须经经纪人复核与编辑**（**逐字「OpenAI email drafting with **mandatory broker review/editing**」**）**；**⑥ **本地运行步骤逐条给出**（**从 `.env.example` 复制、`npm install`（建议 Node 20+）、`npm run db:deploy`、`npm run db:seed`、`npm run dev` 后开 `localhost:3000`**）**。**⑩ ⭐ 可与本站条目并读**：[[application-fill-provenance]]、[[bill-auditor-india]]、[[prediction-lab-actuarial]]、[[kong-insurance-api-bundle]]、[[insurance-data-tools]]、[[policy-explainer-ai]]、[[insurance-recommendation-engine]]、[[embedded-pet-insurance-sdk]]、[[insurance-client-attribution]]、[[insurance-governance]]。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️ **许可实测为 **NONE****——**实测该仓库**无任何许可文件**，**README 亦无许可章节**；**⚠️ 故**本词条**不主张**其代码、schema、迁移或种子数据可在任何条件下使用**，**使用或再分发前应先向作者确认授权**。**② ⚠️⚠️ **本次**未运行该平台的任何一步****——**未克隆、未 `npm install`、未建 PostgreSQL、未运行 `npm run db:deploy`／`db:seed`／`dev`／`test`／`typecheck`／`build`、未打开其 Vercel 地址**；**故**本词条**不主张**其平台可用、其六项测试通过、其续保分桶与跟进状态计算正确、或其 AI 起草端点确实受授权保护**——**⭐ 本词条核实到的是**README 的逐字声明与其文件结构**（**98 个条目**）。**③ ⚠️⚠️ **未读任何 `.ts`／`.tsx`／Prisma schema 或迁移文件的内容****——**⭐ 即**本词条**未核对**：**「每个数据查询与每个 REST 端点都做按用户授权」是否确实成立**（**⚠️ 这是本条最需要后续核实的一处**——**⭐ 这是一个**安全相关的断言**，**而它在本条里**只有 README 作依据**）；**AI 起草端点是否确实拒绝未授权调用**；**那个计费端点是否确实返回 501**；**种子数据是否确实为合成**。**④ ⚠️⚠️ **未核实**其种子数据是否包含任何真实个人信息**——**⭐ 其 README 称开发种子为「realistic development seed data」**，**⚠️ 「realistic」不等于「合成」**，**故**本词条**不主张**其不含真实信息**（**⚠️ 本次未读任何种子文件**）。**⑤ ⚠️⚠️ **未核实**其 AI 起草是否确实只生成行政邮件并保留人工复核**（**⚠️ 未读其提示词或端点实现、未做任何网络观察；**⭐ 本词条**也不主张**其使用 OpenAI 的方式符合任何特定的数据保护要求**）。**⑥ ⚠️ **未核实**其 Stripe 相关端点是否确实返回 501**。**⑦ ⚠️ **未核实**其 Vercel 部署是否仍在运行、以及它是否被配置为生产环境**（**⚠️ 若其 `NODE_ENV=production` 未设，README 所述的启动拒绝缺失密钥便不生效**——**⭐ 本词条**不主张**其部署存在此问题，**只指出这一点无法从仓库判断**）。**⑧ ⭐ ⚠️ **不主张**其可用于真实经纪业务**——**⚠️ 其 README 自己已逐字写明**在处理真实客户数据之前还需加限流与审计留存**，**且**刻意不提供保险建议或保障推荐****。**⑨ ⭐ ⚠️ **未核实**其作者身份、资历或该项目是否被任何经纪公司使用**——**不主张**它被采用**。**⑩ ⭐ **★0、fork 0、无 topics**，**关注度为零**，**不主张其成熟度**；**⚠️ 但 ⭐⭐ 本词条指出：**其 README **仅 2,619 字节**，**而其信息密度很高**（**三条边界 ＋ 一个 501 端点及其原因 ＋ 一条真实数据前置清单 ＋ 六项测试 ＋ 五行的环境变量表**）**——**⭐ 即**文档很短但每一句都在划定范围**的一种形态**；**应如实写出，不用星数代替判断****。**⑪ ⚠️ **创建与推送为同一天（2026-09-08）****——**⭐ 如实记录：**该仓库在**被检索到的那一刻仍非常新**；**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**其成熟度或稳定性**。**⑫ ⚠️ **本条目所记为**2026-09-11 所见****——**该仓库会继续变动**。**核实说明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/Astri299/brokerflow` 于 2026-09-11 经 GitHub API 实测读取（含许可 NONE、★数、fork 数、语言、体量、创建／推送时间、topics 与 homepage）；README 2,619 字节经 `raw.githubusercontent.com` 实测逐字核对（**本词条据其全文引用其开篇三条边界、Included 清单、环境变量表、验证命令与 Production notes**）；**仓库全部 98 个条目**经下载 `codeload.github.com` tarball 后以 `tar tz` 列出核对（**63 文件、35 **brokerflow-renewal-crm**（倉庫 `Astri299/brokerflow`，工具名 BrokerFlow）**是一份面向保險經紀人的 CRM 與續保管理平台**：**管理客戶記錄、保單、續保時間線與行政跟進**，**自稱** **「a **production-oriented MVP** for insurance brokers」**，**其首頁部署在 Vercel**（**實測 `homepage` 字段為 `https://brokerflow-nine.vercel.app`**）。**實測 ★0、fork 0、許可 **NONE**（**實測該倉庫無任何許可文件**）、主語言 TypeScript、體量 108 KB、**創建與最後推送均為 2026-09-08（同日）**、無 topics**（**創建與推送均在解凍窗口之內**）；**README 實測 2,619 位元組**；**倉庫實測共 98 個條目（63 個文件、35 個目錄）**。本條目屬本輪主題**「按部分聲明：許可、能力、交付物與使用者各自適用什麼規則」**；**⭐⭐⭐ 它是四條裡**把「能力按部分分」寫得最乾淨的一條****。

可核實資訊（**均 README 與倉庫實測**）：⭐⭐⭐ **① 開篇一句裡同時劃出三條邊界，且三條各管一件事**：**「BrokerFlow is a **production-oriented MVP** for insurance brokers to manage client records, policies, renewal timelines, and administrative follow-ups. **It intentionally does not provide insurance advice or coverage recommendations. AI only drafts editable administrative email copy; no email is sent by the application.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **四處**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 第一條否掉的是這門生意的核心產出**（保險建議與保障推薦）——**⭐ 即**一個經紀人的工具明確說自己**不給建議****；**② ⭐⭐⭐ 第二條把 AI 的作用收窄到兩個限定詞**（「**只**起草」「**可編輯的**草稿」）——**⭐ 即**它既不自動決定內容，也不把草稿當成終稿****；**③ ⭐⭐⭐ 第三條回答了一個常被跳過的問題：**這個產物由誰發出****（**「no email is sent by the application」，本應用不發送任何郵件**）——**⭐ 三條裡這一條最實在：前兩條說的是「不做什麼」，這一條說的是「做了也不會自己發出去」****；**④ 三句合起來把「AI 做什麼／不做什麼／它的產物由誰發出」分完了，且全部寫在第一段**。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **一個聲明為未實現的端點，明確返回「未實現」**：**「**Stripe-ready protected billing endpoint（returns 501 until products are configured）**」**⭐⭐⭐ **三處**：**① ⭐⭐⭐「未實現」被做成了一個可觀察的響應**（HTTP 501）——**⭐ 即**調用方不會以為它成功了，也不會遇到一個無解釋的失敗****；**② ⭐⭐ 它把這個端點仍列在「Included（已包含）」清單裡，同時在括號裡寫明實際狀態**（「已經有了架子」與「還不能用」被同時說清）；**③ 這與本站第 341 輪 [[kakekomi-corpus]] 的「gap 作為返回值」同族：**「尚不可用」被做成了一個有類型、有名字的輸出****。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **它逐字說明**為什麼**那件事沒做，而不是說「即將推出」**：**「Stripe checkout/webhooks are **deliberately prepared but not activated because product/price IDs and billing policy were not supplied**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **三處**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 它區分了**代碼側已完成**與**信息側未提供**——**⭐ 即**未實現的原因不在代碼，而在缺失的輸入（產品／價格 ID 與計費政策）****；**② ⭐⭐「deliberately prepared」說明架子是有意留的**（不是遺漏）；**③ 這是本站所收條目裡**對「某個東西為什麼還沒做」寫得最不含糊的一處之一****。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **它把「還不能用於真實客戶數據」寫成了一條前置清單**：**「Use managed PostgreSQL with backups, configure `AUTH_SECRET` uniquely per environment, set `NODE_ENV=production`（**secure cookies; startup rejects a missing secret**），provision an OpenAI key only where drafting is desired, and **add rate limiting/audit retention at the platform edge before handling real client data**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **四處**：**① ⭐⭐⭐「在處理**真實客戶數據之前**，先要在平台邊緣加上限流與審計留存」**——**⭐ 即**它把**哪一步之前不能做什麼**寫清楚了**（這是「按部分聲明」在**使用者**維度上最實用的一處：讀者據此知道它現在**不該**被用在哪裡）；**② 其餘前置項也逐條具體**（託管數據庫帶備份／每個環境用不同的 AUTH_SECRET／設 NODE_ENV=production）；**③ ⭐⭐「啟動時會拒絕缺失的密鑰」**（配置錯誤會讓服務**起不來**，而不是悄悄降級）；**④ ⭐⭐ AI 密鑰只在需要起草時才配**（不默認開啟）。**⑤ ⭐⭐ **其測試清單逐項可讀，且覆蓋的正是上面那三條邊界的實現面**：**「The automated test suite covers **session integrity, unauthenticated API authorization, client/policy input validation, renewal categorization, follow-up status calculation, and AI-draft endpoint authorization**.」**；**驗證命令逐字為** **「Run `npm run typecheck`, `npm test`, and `npm run build`.」**⭐⭐⭐ **三處**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 六項測試裡有兩項指向授權與鑑權**（未鑑權 API 授權、AI 起草端點的授權）——**⭐ 即**「誰能調用 AI 起草」是被測過的****；**② ⭐⭐「續保分桶」與「跟進狀態計算」被單獨列為測試項**（業務規則不只寫在文檔裡）；**③ 驗證是三件事**（類型檢查、測試、構建）。**⑥ ⭐⭐ **續保按四桶劃分且邊界明確**：**「**Renewal buckets: overdue, 0–7 days, 8–30 days, and 31+ days**」**⭐⭐ **兩處**：**① ⭐⭐ 四桶的分界是**可核對的數字****（「緊迫程度」被寫成了**區間而不是形容詞**）；**②「逾期」被單列成一桶**。**⑦ ⭐ **其環境變量表逐項註明必需性與用途，且有一條隱私說明**：**`DATABASE_URL`（必需）／`AUTH_SECRET`（必需，**32+ 位元組**）／`OPENAI_API_KEY`（**起草郵件時需要；保存在服務端；絕不暴露給瀏覽器**）／`OPENAI_MODEL`（可選，**默認為 `gpt-4o-mini`**）／Stripe 變量（可選，**保留**）**⭐⭐⭐ **三處**：**① ⭐⭐⭐「保存在服務端；絕不暴露給瀏覽器」是一條**明確的安全邊界描述****；**② 必需與可選項逐行區分，且密鑰有長度要求**；**③ 模型名給出默認值**。**⑧ ⭐⭐ **一處需如實指出的**已提交的演示憑據****：**「The seed login is `demo@brokerflow.local` / `DemoPassword123!`; **use it only in local development**.」**⭐⭐ **三處**：**①**演示賬號與口令被寫進 README**；**② ⭐⭐ 它逐字標註只能在本地開發使用**；**③ ⚠️ 提示：**這類演示憑據若被誤用到任何對外部署上，就是一處真實的口令弱化**——**⭐ 不主張該項目已發生這種情況，只指出該憑據是公開可讀的****。**⑨ ⭐ **其餘可核實細節**：會話用簽名且 HttpOnly 的 cookie；每個數據查詢與每個 REST 端點都做按用戶的授權；客戶、保單與跟進都有 CRUD API 與操作界面；技術棧為 Prisma ＋ PostgreSQL（含首個遷移與真實感的開發種子數據）；**AI 起草必須經經紀人複核與編輯**（逐字「OpenAI email drafting with **mandatory broker review/editing**」）；本地運行步驟逐條給出**。**⑩ ⭐ 可與 [[application-fill-provenance]]、[[bill-auditor-india]]、[[prediction-lab-actuarial]]、[[kong-insurance-api-bundle]]、[[insurance-data-tools]]、[[policy-explainer-ai]]、[[insurance-recommendation-engine]]、[[embedded-pet-insurance-sdk]]、[[insurance-client-attribution]]、[[insurance-governance]] 並讀**。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**① ⚠️⚠️ **許可實測為 **NONE****——**實測該倉庫**無任何許可文件**，**README 亦無許可章節**；**⚠️ 故**不主張**其代碼、schema、遷移或種子數據可在任何條件下使用**，**使用或再分發前應先向作者確認授權**。**② ⚠️⚠️ **未運行該平台的任何一步****——**未克隆、未 `npm install`、未建 PostgreSQL、未運行 `db:deploy`／`db:seed`／`dev`／`test`／`typecheck`／`build`、未打開其 Vercel 地址**；**故**不主張**其平台可用、其六項測試通過、其續保分桶與跟進狀態計算正確、或其 AI 起草端點確實受授權保護**——**⭐ 本詞條核實到的是**README 的逐字聲明與其文件結構**（98 個條目）。**③ ⚠️⚠️ **未讀任何 `.ts`／`.tsx`／Prisma schema 或遷移文件的內容****——**⭐ 即**未核對**「每個數據查詢與每個 REST 端點都做按用戶授權」是否確實成立**（**⚠️ 這是本條最需要後續核實的一處**；**⭐ 這是一個**安全相關的斷言**，**而它在本條裡**只有 README 作依據**）；**AI 起草端點是否確實拒絕未授權調用**；**那個計費端點是否確實返回 501**；**種子數據是否確實為合成**。**④ ⚠️⚠️ **未核實**其種子數據是否包含任何真實個人信息****（**⭐ 其 README 稱開發種子為「realistic development seed data」**，**⚠️「realistic」不等於「合成」**，**故**不主張**其不含真實信息**）。**⑤ ⚠️⚠️ **未核實**其 AI 起草是否確實只生成行政郵件並保留人工複核**（**未讀其提示詞或端點實現、未做任何網絡觀察**）。**⑥ ⚠️ **未核實**其 Stripe 相關端點是否確實返回 501**。**⑦ ⚠️ **未核實**其 Vercel 部署是否仍在運行、以及它是否被配置為生產環境**（**⚠️ 若其 `NODE_ENV=production` 未設，README 所述的啟動拒絕缺失密鑰便不生效**——**⭐ 不主張其部署存在此問題，只指出這一點無法從倉庫判斷**）。**⑧ ⭐ ⚠️ **不主張**其可用於真實經紀業務**（**⚠️ 其 README 自己已逐字寫明**在處理真實客戶數據之前還需加限流與審計留存**，**且**刻意不提供保險建議或保障推薦****）。**⑨ ⭐ ⚠️ **未核實**其作者身份、資歷或該項目是否被任何經紀公司使用**。**⑩ ⭐ **★0、fork 0、無 topics**，**不主張其成熟度**；**⚠️ 但 ⭐⭐ 其 README 僅 2,619 位元組，而信息密度很高**（三條邊界＋一個 501 端點及其原因＋一條真實數據前置清單＋六項測試＋五行環境變量表）**——**⭐ 即**文檔很短但每一句都在劃定範圍**的一種形態****。**⑪ ⚠️ **創建與推送為同一天（2026-09-08）****——**該倉庫在被檢索到的那一刻仍非常新**。**⑫ ⚠️ **本條目所記為**2026-09-11 所見****。**核實說明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/Astri299/brokerflow` 於 2026-09-11 經 GitHub API 實測讀取；README 2,619 位元組經 raw 實測逐字核對；**全部 98 個條目**經下載 tarball 後以 `tar tz` 列出核對（63 文件、35 目錄）；**未克隆、未安裝、未建數據庫、未運行任何命令、未讀任何源碼／schema／遷移／種子內容、未打開其線上地址、未做任何網絡觀察、未打開任何圖**。

**brokerflow-renewal-crm** (repository `Astri299/brokerflow`, tool name BrokerFlow) **is a CRM and renewal-management platform for insurance brokers** covering **client records, policies, renewal timelines and administrative follow-ups**, self-described as **a production-oriented MVP for insurance brokers**, with a front end deployed on Vercel (its homepage field measurably points there). **Measured ★0, 0 forks, licence **NONE** (the repository measurably has no licence file), primary language TypeScript, a 108 KB repository, created and last pushed on the same day, 2026-09-08, no topics** (all GitHub API measurements; **creation and push both fall inside the thaw window**); **the README measures 2,619 bytes**; **the repository measures 98 entries (63 files, 35 directories)**. This entry belongs to this round’s theme that **a system should be declared part by part, with each part’s applicable rules stated**; ⭐⭐⭐ **of the four it is the one that draws capability boundaries most cleanly**.

Verifiable details (**read from the README and measured in the repository**): ⭐⭐⭐ **① The opening sentence draws three boundaries at once, each governing a different thing** — **the most notable point in this entry**: verbatim, BrokerFlow is a production-oriented MVP for insurance brokers to manage client records, policies, renewal timelines and administrative follow-ups, **it intentionally does not provide insurance advice or coverage recommendations, the AI only drafts editable administrative email copy, and no email is sent by the application** ⭐⭐⭐ **Four things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **the first clause denies the core output of the business itself, insurance advice and coverage recommendations, so a broker’s tool states plainly that it gives no advice**; ⭐⭐⭐ **the second narrows the AI’s role with two qualifiers, that it only drafts and that the drafts are editable, so it neither decides content nor treats a draft as final**; ⭐⭐⭐ **the third answers a question that is usually skipped, namely who sends the output, stating that no email is sent by the application — of the three the most substantive, since the first two say what it does not do while this one says that even what it does do is not sent on its own**; **and together the three settle what the AI does, what it does not do, and who sends its output, all in the first paragraph**. **② ⭐⭐⭐ An endpoint declared unimplemented, which answers plainly that it is not implemented** — verbatim, a billing endpoint is protected and Stripe-ready but **returns 501 until products are configured** ⭐⭐⭐ **Three things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **unimplemented becomes an observable response, an HTTP 501, so a caller neither assumes success nor meets an unexplained failure**; ⭐⭐ **the endpoint is still listed among what is included, with its actual state given in parentheses, so having a scaffold and not yet being usable are stated together**; **and this is the same family as round 341’s gap returned as a value, since "not yet available" becomes a typed, named output**. **③ ⭐⭐⭐ It states verbatim why the thing was not built rather than saying it is coming soon** — verbatim, checkout and webhooks are **deliberately prepared but not activated because product and price identifiers and billing policy were not supplied** ⭐⭐⭐ **Three things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **it separates what is done on the code side from what was not supplied on the information side, so the reason for the gap is a missing input rather than the code**; ⭐⭐ **"deliberately prepared" says the scaffold was left on purpose rather than omitted**; **and this is among the least ambiguous accounts this site has collected of why something has not been built**, ⭐ **the same family as round 342’s note that a better prior would be the natural fix and had not been built or measured**. **④ ⭐⭐⭐ It turns "not yet usable with real client data" into a checklist** — verbatim, use managed PostgreSQL with backups, configure the auth secret uniquely per environment, set the production environment variable (**secure cookies, and startup rejects a missing secret**), provision an AI key only where drafting is desired, **and add rate limiting and audit retention at the platform edge before handling real client data** ⭐⭐⭐ **Four things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **adding rate limiting and audit retention before handling real client data states which step must precede what, the most practical instance of part-by-part declaration along the user dimension, since a reader learns where it should not yet be used**; **the other prerequisites are equally specific**; ⭐⭐ **startup rejecting a missing secret means a configuration error stops the service rather than degrading it quietly**; **and ⭐⭐ the AI key is provisioned only where drafting is wanted, so it is off by default**. **⑤ ⭐⭐ Its test list is itemised and covers the implementation side of those three boundaries** — verbatim, the automated suite covers **session integrity, unauthenticated API authorization, client and policy input validation, renewal categorisation, follow-up status calculation, and authorization on the AI-draft endpoint**, with verification by a type check, the test suite and a build ⭐⭐⭐ **Three things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **two of the six concern authorization, including authorization on the AI-draft endpoint, so who may call the drafter is tested** — ⭐ **the same family as round 342’s integration test for approval permission**; ⭐⭐ **renewal categorisation and follow-up status calculation are listed as separate test items, so business rules are not only documented**; **and verification is three commands rather than tests alone**. **⑥ ⭐⭐ Renewals are bucketed four ways with explicit edges** — verbatim, overdue, zero to seven days, eight to thirty days, and thirty-one days or more ⭐⭐ **Two things**: ⭐⭐ **the edges are checkable numbers, so urgency is written as intervals rather than adjectives**; **and overdue is its own bucket rather than folded into the first interval**. **⑦ ⭐ Its environment-variable table marks each entry required or optional and contains one privacy statement** — the database URL and a 32-byte-or-longer auth secret are required, the AI key is needed to draft emails and **kept server-side and never exposed to the browser**, the model name is optional and defaults to a named small model, and the payment variables are optional and reserved ⭐⭐⭐ **Three things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **"kept server-side, never exposed to the browser" is an explicit statement of a security boundary rather than a general claim of being secure**; **required and optional are distinguished line by line and the secret carries a length requirement**; **and the model has a stated default, so leaving it unset still runs**. **⑧ ⭐⭐ One committed demo credential must be recorded** — verbatim, the seed login is a named demo account with a stated password, **to be used only in local development** ⭐⭐ **Three things**: **a demo account and password are written into the README**; ⭐⭐ **use is restricted verbatim to local development**; **and ⚠️ the entry notes that such a credential used on any public deployment would be a real weakening, without claiming that has happened here, only that the credential is publicly readable** (⭐ **the production environment variable and the startup rejection of a missing secret both suggest the author is aware of production configuration**). **⑨ ⭐ Other checkable details**: **sessions use signed HTTP-only cookies**; **per-user authorization is applied to every data query and every REST endpoint**; **clients, policies and follow-ups each have CRUD APIs and screens**; **the stack is Prisma with PostgreSQL, including a first migration and realistic development seed data**; **AI drafting requires mandatory broker review and editing**; **and local run steps are listed command by command**. **⑩ ⭐ Readable with** [[application-fill-provenance]], [[bill-auditor-india]], [[prediction-lab-actuarial]], [[kong-insurance-api-bundle]], [[insurance-data-tools]], [[policy-explainer-ai]], [[insurance-recommendation-engine]], [[embedded-pet-insurance-sdk]], [[insurance-client-attribution]] and [[insurance-governance]].
